title: Chlorogenic acid inhibits proliferation in human hepatoma cells by suppressing noncanonical NF-kappaB signaling pathway and triggering mitochondrial apoptosis.
authors: Jiang, Yanfei; Nan, Hao; Shi, Na; Hao, Wenfang; Dong, Juane; Chen, Hongying
one_liner_zh: 研究绿原酸抑制肝癌细胞增殖的NF-kB信号通路与线粒体凋亡机制，属纯细胞实验与信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chlorogenic acid (CGA), a phenylpropanoid derived from Eucommia ulmoides Oliver, has been shown to exhibit potent cytotoxic and anti-proliferative activities against several human cancers. However, the effects of CGA on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and the underlying mechanisms have not been intensively studied. In this study, the CGA treatment effects on the viability of human hepatoma cells were investigated by MTT assay. Our data showed that CGA could dose-dependently inhibit the activity of human hepatoma cells Hep-G2 and Huh-7, but did not affect the activity and growth of normal human hepatocyte QSG-7701. The genes and pathways influenced by CGA treatment were explored by RNA sequencing and bioinformatics analysis, which identified 323 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) involved in multiple pharmacological signaling pathways such as MAPK, NF-kappaB, apoptosis and TGF-beta signaling pathways. Further analyses by real-time quantitative PCR, Western blot and flow cytometry revealed that CGA effectually suppressed the noncanonical NF-kappaB signaling pathway, meanwhile it activated the mitochondrial apoptosis of HCC by upregulation of the BH3-only protein Bcl-2 binding component 3 (BBC3). Our findings demonstrated the potential of CGA in suppressing human hepatoma cells and provided a new insight into the anti-cancer mechanism of CGA.
abstract_zh: 绿原酸（CGA），一种源自杜仲（Eucommia ulmoides Oliver）的苯丙素类化合物，已被证明对多种人类癌症具有强效的细胞毒性和抗增殖活性。然而，CGA对肝细胞癌（HCC）的作用及其潜在机制尚未得到深入研究。本研究通过MTT实验检测了CGA处理对人肝癌细胞活力的影响。数据显示，CGA能剂量依赖性地抑制人肝癌细胞Hep-G2和Huh-7的活性，但不影响正常人肝细胞QSG-7701的活性和生长。通过RNA测序和生物信息学分析，探讨了CGA处理影响的基因和通路，鉴定出323个差异表达基因（DEGs），涉及多种药理学信号通路，如MAPK、NF-kappaB、凋亡和TGF-beta信号通路。进一步通过实时定量PCR、Western blot和流式细胞术分析揭示，CGA有效抑制了非经典NF-kappaB信号通路，同时通过上调BH3-only蛋白Bcl-2结合成分3（BBC3）激活了HCC的线粒体凋亡。我们的发现证明了CGA在抑制人肝癌细胞方面的潜力，并为CGA的抗癌机制提供了新的见解。
